title: Finish is the whole argument
body: A shadow gap that runs true, a door that closes quietly. We would rather delay a handover than explain away a detail.

title: One team, start to snag list
body: The people who draw it stay on the project until it is signed off. No hand-offs to a name the client has never met.

title: We answer after the invoice
body: Service is not a department we outsource. Our own engineers return to the homes and offices we have built.

title: Priced and said plainly
body: Line-item budgets, honest timelines, and an early phone call when something changes. Clients come back because nothing surprised them.
